headline: CH jumps 30.30% on a 42.1σ volume spike while A plunges 100% on an open price gap.
market_take: Today's coverage shows strong upside in FOOD, led by CH and AQUA, and solid gains in PF&REIT with M-STOR. At the same time, CONSTRUCTION stocks TRITN and PLE and PROP name A suffered steep drops. Several unusual‑trading alerts point to heightened volatility, notably CPNCG's capital reduction filing alongside a 4.0σ volume spike.
